title: Curve Move Body Stuck
description: When selecting a curve (edge) and moving it, only endpoints move but the NURBS body stays stuck. Fix transform/move and gumball to translate all poles on selected edges, not only endpoint vertices.
summary: Moving a selected curve only updated endpoint vertices; NURBS interior poles stayed fixed so the curve body looked stuck. Added collectTargetEdges and selectionTargetsPointTransformDiff to translate/rotate/scale all poles on topology-selected edges (edge/wire/face/…), while vertex-only picks still move a single endpoint. Wired transform.move, rotate/scale actions, and gumball commit through the shared path; selectionTargetsCenter includes nurbs poles for correct gumball pivot. Tests cover full-edge vs vertex-only moves.
